name: Collectionentity Pattern
description: To represent domain (not set theory) membership.
scenarios: My saxophone collection includes a Mark VI tenor, a Balanced Action alto, and a Conn Transitional bari.
competency_questions: What things are contained in this collection (community, collective)? What collections this thing is member of?
